title: `tadu close` turns the section heading into the category when the closed item already carries its own date and bold category
notes: In teleporte-web on 2026-11-16, closing `- [ ] 2026-11-16 — **Coverage database hardening (final review minors):** ...`, listed under `## Mailbox and chat pass (2026-11-15)`, wrote `- [x] 2026-11-16 — **Mailbox and chat pass (2026-11-15):** 2026-11-16 — **Coverage database hardening ...`. The same shape is in that repo's TODO_LOG.md at lines 332, 341, 1550 and 1581, and `tadu doctor` passes it. Smallest next step: a failing test that closes such an item, then reuse the item's own date and category instead of prefixing the heading.
